design.leave_one_family_out: held-out input family and its donor tissue are both excluded from estimator training
design.utility_oracle: -d masked validation NLL / de at e=0

experiment: MINI Cells Experiment 019 — Proposal Utility Discovery

interpretation.boundary_only: Boundary success without local success means proposal utility is observable at the language interface but a genuinely local endogenous error field is still missing.
interpretation.cost: 019 measures signal existence, not cheap-probe efficiency. The epsilon probe currently executes the same cellular rule and must be compressed in a later experiment before claiming compute savings.
interpretation.fail: Do not tune another recruitment threshold. Either the oracle is inconsistent or the recorded endogenous observables do not contain enough proposal-specific utility information.
interpretation.local: A local signal means parent/proposal dynamics alone generalize to unseen input and tissue families; this is the evidence needed before implementing a shared local recruitment gate.
interpretation.partial: Some held-out families are predictable, but the signal is not yet architecture-general.

numerical_validation.repair: fold-local finite-training-median imputation; all-nonfinite training columns -> zero

question: Can label-free local or boundary observables predict the true marginal value of a sleeping capability-tissue proposal across held-out skill families?
